messages.author: 1004dd6f66bb10c3
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: prior in stan
parts:
You mean the inverse-scale parameter set close to 0, right? And don't
you also need to set the shape parameter very close to 0?

To my mind it's simpler and clearer to just code it up directly using lp__:

lp__ <- lp__ - log(a);

Note that this is an improper prior, since the integral of 1/a from 0
to infinity diverges. It's equivalent to a uniform distribution on log
a, so if you wanted to get fancy you could also write

parameters {
real loga;
}
transformed parameters {
real<lower=0> a;
a <- exp(loga);
}
model {
# p(loga) \propto 1
}

Matt
